ingredient_line: 1½ lbs. (700 grams) chicken boneless (Preferably thighs, or breasts)
½ cup (120 ml) Greek yogurt (hung curd)
½ to 1 teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder (use less for low heat, use 1½ teaspoons for extra heat)
1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste (or ¾ tbsp grated ginger + ¾ tbsp grated garlic)
1 tablespoon oil (mustard oil if you have)
1½ cups (180 grams) onions (fine chopped, 1x - 1 large or 2 medium)
1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste (or ¾ tbsp grated ginger + ¾ tbsp grated garlic)
½ to 1 teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder (can use up to 1 tablespoon for extra heat)
1 lb. (450 grams) tomatoes (pureed/chopped or 10 oz. (1¼ cup) tomato puree/ passata or 14 oz can peeled tomatoes, read notes)
½ cup heavy cream/whipping cream (or 1x - ⅓ cup whole raw cashews, 30, refer notes)
300 grams Chicken cut into small size pieces
2 teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder (mild, adjust to taste)
1 teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder (adjust to taste)
1 cup Tomato Puree (canned (do not use tomato paste))
½ kg (1.2 lbs) chicken ((bone-in preferred but boneless is ok) )
3 tablespoons curd (plain yogurt or coconut milk)
1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste (or ½ tbsps. each fine grated)
¾ to 1 teaspoon garam masala (or korma masala)
1 to 1¼ teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder (less spicy variety, minimum ½ tsp)
10 whole cashew nuts (or almonds (or use 5 each))
¼ cup curd (plain yogurt or coconut milk)
1 to 2 tablespoon oil or ghee (use as per your preference)
1 to 2 green chilies (slit or chopped (optional, Thai/Indian or serrano peppers))
½ cup hot water (more if needed)
½ to ¾ teaspoon garam masala
¼ teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder (optional, for color)
2 tablespoons coriander leaves ((cilantro) fine chopped to garnish)
2 teaspoon Curd (Dahi / Yogurt) beaten with a little water
2 tablespoon Sesame seeds (Til seeds) ground to paste
2 tablespoons oil (use oil of choice, I used mustard oil )
3 cups packed methi (fenugreek) leaves (75 grams, chopped, may double this quantity of methi for stronger methi flavor)
250 grams mixed greens like spinach, bathua (chenopodium) (I used mix of spinach, turnip and collard greens )
3 inch white radish (mooli) (chopped, around 1/2 cup chopped radish)
1 bunch mustard leaves / sarson ke patte
